provenance.description: Hand-authored from the accepted contract, not captured from VOA and not generated by a parser, renderer, or serializer.

projection_convention: content_lines are logical user-facing content, not pixel/ANSI goldens. Empty strings denote retained empty blocks/rows. Presentation notes state additional constraints; focus, width, color, and atomic boundary styling still need review.

all: Parsing/rendering must not panic or expose raw markup or hidden Opaque source data.
No Description operation changes the enclosing Task Done state.
Expectations are unreviewed; changes require a reviewed diff, not regeneration from implementation output.
Native: Round-trip structure, decoded text, marks and depth, block boundaries, list state, Link destinations/attributes, and exact decoded Code content wherever applicable.
Only contract-permitted representation changes are allowed.
mixed Native/Opaque: Native assertions apply to Native content.
Retained outermost Opaque subtrees preserve exact original UTF-8 bytes, identity, order, nesting, and parent position after unrelated edits.
Opaque content is atomic, skipped by formatting, copied only as its safe projection, and removed/replaced only with confirmation.
A failed save-time preservation check rejects save and keeps the draft open.
Blocked: Ordinary structured edits and saves are rejected; no automatic sanitize-and-save.
Confirmed Clear Description creates an empty unsaved draft; discard preserves the original source.
Confirmed Recover text creates a safe plain-text unsaved draft in Insert Mode; save intentionally replaces the original source.
